GAP 1 (the spine) — implement in D:/GitHub/agent-foundry/recursive_language_model/src/rlm/context.py and src/rlm/sandbox.py per shared/designs.md sections 1.2-1.5. In context.py add to ContextStore: (a) `sub_context(self, *, start_line=None, end_line=None, start_char=None, end_char=None, workspace: Path | None = None) -> ContextStore` — exactly one of (start_line/end_line) xor (start_char/end_char) must be given (ValueError otherwise); line ranges 1-indexed inclusive consistent with `lines()`, char ranges 0-indexed end-exclusive consistent with `__getitem__`; streams the slice into a new file under `<workspace or fresh child_<uuid4> dir>/context.txt`, recomputes char_count/line_count for the slice; raises RuntimeError if no context loaded (mirror `path` property behavior). (b) `from_slice(cls, source, *, ... ) -> ContextStore` classmethod alias calling `source.sub_context(...)`. (c) `clone(self, *, workspace: Path | None = None) -> ContextStore` — full streaming copy of this store's backing file into a NEW workspace dir (default fresh child dir), returns a NEW ContextStore with a different `.path` than self (even for an empty store), copies char_count/line_count as-is. Child workspaces nest under `<parent_workspace>/children/<uuid4>/`. In sandbox.py add `PythonSandbox.set_context_store(self, store: ContextStore, *, lock: bool = True) -> None` which binds `store` directly as `namespace['context']`, with lock=True preventing the loop's automatic per-turn set_context() from overwriting it; retain existing `set_context(str|Path)` unchanged for CLI /load and top-level use. Full type hints, ruff format/check clean, pyrefly clean (line 88). Append a detailed implementation-notes.md entry covering the line-range O(end_line) streaming cost tradeoff (documented per designs.md section 7) and the child-workspace nesting scheme. Commit locally with conventional commit message.

Change `SubagentRunner.__init__` to accept `model_for_depth: ModelForDepth` (replacing the single `model: str` param). In `run_child`/`run_children_parallel`/`_run_child_async`, resolve the child's model via `self._model_for_depth(self._depth + 1)` and construct the grandchild SubagentRunner with the SAME `model_for_depth` callable (propagation by reuse, no re-derivation). Full type hints, ruff format/check clean, pyrefly clean (line 88). Append implementation-notes.md entry. Commit locally with conventional commit message.

Internally, on every call: `store = context if context is not None else ContextStore.from_string("")`, then `context_clone = store.clone(workspace=<new child workspace dir>)` (using T010's clone), then `child_sandbox.set_context_store(context_clone)` (T010's method). In D:/GitHub/agent-foundry/recursive_language_model/src/rlm/sandbox.py: change the `llm_query`/`llm_query_many` tool-function signatures exposed in the namespace to `llm_query(prompt: str, context: ContextStore | None = None) -> object` and `llm_query_many(prompts: list[str], contexts: list[ContextStore | None] | None = None) -> list[object]`; passing a `str` for `context` must raise `TypeError` with a message pointing at `context.sub_context(...)` / `ContextStore.from_string(...)`. Remove the old `_build_prompt` string-concatenation entirely — `prompt` is passed as the child's initial user message unchanged. Full type hints, ruff format/check clean, pyrefly clean (line 88). Append implementation-notes.md entry documenting the FINAL(None) limitation per designs.md section 7. Commit locally with conventional commit message.

GAP 4a — synthetic dataset generators per shared/designs.md section 5.2. Create D:/GitHub/agent-foundry/recursive_language_model/evals/datasets.py with seeded (default seed=42), deterministic generators for 4 benchmarks: (1) `generate_sniah(seed, ...) -> ...` — S-NIAH-style: N-char synthetic document of filler sentences with one or more short 'needle' facts inserted at controlled positions, plus a question whose answer is only in the needle, plus expected answer for exact/substring-match scoring. (2) `generate_browsecomp(seed, ...) -> ...` — multi-doc corpus QA: K synthetic documents (a few paragraphs each), one containing the answer; a question requiring identifying the relevant doc and extracting an answer; expected answer. (3) `generate_oolong_classification(seed, n_items=20, ...) -> ...` — long context with many short labeled question/category examples using label set {ABBR, ENTY, DESC, HUM, LOC, NUM} (trec_coarse-style) plus a final unlabeled query per item; expected label. (4) `generate_oolong_pairs(seed, ...) -> ...` — two long synthetic contexts (A, B) plus a comparison question (e.g. 'which of A/B mentions X more recently?') plus expected answer. Each generator returns a small dataclass/typed structure with fields for context text(s), question, expected_answer, and any metadata needed by run_eval.py. Full type hints, ruff format/check clean, pyrefly clean (line 88). Append implementation-notes.md entry. Commit locally with conventional commit message.
